name: EVA overexertion
source: Stahn et al. 2017 (core temperature can exceed 40 °C during exercise in space); sweat biomarker table (lactate, sodium ranges)
note: Mert overexerts and builds up heat while doing heavy surface work (carrying a panel). Target values come from the plan table. When mandatory crew rest is applied, heart rate, breathing, lactate and core temperature recover to baseline.
